---
name: Feature
about: Propose a change
---

**Mission test** — which running cost does this cut? (See `docs/USE-CASES.md`. Proposals that substitute for trust, care, intent, or time — auto-send, generic drafts, engagement metrics — are out of scope and will be closed kindly.)

**The scenario** — a concrete moment where a user would want this.

**Sketch** — which package would own it, and which contract it reads/writes.
